subject.title: feat(apple): port the working claw indicator, wait phrases, and turn recap to iOS/macOS

question: Should Apple chat inherit the web recap resolver’s documented 30-second same-session attribution residual, or should the native port omit/defer the recap until terminal session rows carry a run identity?
rationale: The limitation is intentional rather than a mechanical defect, affects user-visible per-turn attribution, and the companion web design is still open rather than established merged behavior.

options.title: Accept parity with the documented residual
options.body: Keep the recap port, document the same known limitation, and require native runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Ship the indicator without recap
options.body: Land the claw and long-wait status behavior while deferring the potentially misattributed recap until a run-identity contract exists.

options.title: Defer the Apple port
options.body: Wait for the companion web direction and a shared terminal-row identity solution before adopting this user-visible behavior on Apple.

recommendation.title: Accept parity with the documented residual
recommendation.body: Keep the recap port, document the same known limitation, and require native runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the companion web design and this shared Apple implementation, so they are best positioned to explain the intended parity boundary.
